notes.title: Plagueborn 2024 Jan/Feb Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751395/49789d6741e82c4f4f1224d95a513f9ee0e55857.png[/img]

The new map, Downtown, will be accessed through Guaca Village, providing access to two other maps: the hospital and the underground. In Downtown, there will be a new trader and a boss.

New items will be added, including a new vest model and other items that currently serve only for selling but will be used for crafting in the future.

New contracts.

Custom events: these events will occur during the raid, with a probability of happening when entering a new map. Currently, only one event is planned to be implemented, but there is a possibility of having two.

[b]Thank you for reading, see you around, mecenary.[/b]

D8 studio
